what: erratum 004's offline round: derive the ICAPE2 readback sequence, build an independent device model, fail the published RTL against it, then build a real sequencer
board_time: none — no Vivado, no bitstream, no board

derivation.written_before: the model, the bench and the RTL, so the code could be judged against it
sources: UG470 (packet formats, readback transaction, CSIB/RDWRB rules, the dummy frame)
zynq-xpart scripts/hwicap-uart.py readback()/readreg(), MEASURED on an XC7Z010

zynq-xpart rtl/xbus_icap.v + sw/icap_firmware/main.c: all FOUR word orderings tried on an EBAZ4205 against a directly instantiated ICAPE2, and only per-byte bit reversal rewrote the fabric ("mbox reports winning swap mode 1") — MEASURED, exhaustive
derivation.explicitly_rejected: UG470's SelectMAP bus-width detect and its SHUTDOWN/GTS readback-capture flow: this carrier contains the engine doing the reading and must keep running

independent_model.rule: never reads any signal, array or parameter of the DUT; it sees CLK/CSIB/RDWRB/I/O only
independent_model.own_bench: vivado/carrier/tb_icape2_model.v — a literal known-answer trace plus the seven defects, driven word by word by the bench with carrier_stream NOT instantiated
models: byte-bit-reversed wire order: a SelectMAP-order stream never syncs
Type-1/Type-2 packet parsing with its own CMD/FAR/IDCODE/STAT registers
configuration memory keyed by FAR, with FAR successors computed from the address format
the one-frame write buffer: five frames in, four land
a readback that serves the frame buffer first and configuration memory after
abort on RDWRB moving while CSIB is Low
independent_model.cross_check: the successor rule reproduces the manifest's flush FARs unaided, including A23 -> A80 and C23 -> C80, which are not FAR+1

published_rtl_against_the_model.verdict: REFUTED, and more broadly than erratum 004 stated
published_rtl_against_the_model.device_error: E_ABORT (RDWRB moved while CSIB was Low, on the way into the readback)
published_rtl_against_the_model.reading: not one word of frame data was ever read, and not one frame ever reached the fabric — the write never synced either

defects_found_beyond_erratum_004.what: ICAPE2 word ordering, on the WRITE path as well as the read path
defects_found_beyond_erratum_004.detail: carrier_top wires icap_din straight to ICAPE2.I while carrier_stream forwards SelectMAP-order envelope words; the primitive's I/O is bit-reversed within each byte, so the sync word never matched and pass 2's writes were almost certainly never accepted
defects_found_beyond_erratum_004.consequence: the erratum-003 calibration is not evidence that anything was written to the fabric
defects_found_beyond_erratum_004.fix: br8() at the ICAP pins only; the CRC, the staging RAM, the host and the manifest keep SelectMAP order

defects_found_beyond_erratum_004.what: CSIB held Low continuously through the readback
defects_found_beyond_erratum_004.detail: carrier_crc32 accepts one word every four cycles; a real device delivers one word per Low-CSIB clock, so three words in four were being discarded
defects_found_beyond_erratum_004.why_invisible: the old bench's device was indexed by the DUT's own frame_word, so a paused consumer was served the same word again
defects_found_beyond_erratum_004.fix: one word in flight, requested only when the consumer can take it

defects_found_beyond_erratum_004.what: an unconditional phase assignment overwrote the F_READBACK refusal at the end of an envelope
defects_found_beyond_erratum_004.detail: the frame-count refusal set fault_code and phase, and the line after it set phase unconditionally to P_IDLE — leaving fault_code set and fault clear

defects_found_beyond_erratum_004.what: host FAULT_NAMES had no entry for F_PROTOCOL (11)

sequencer_as_built.shape: sync + Type-1 read IDCODE -> 32 NOOP flush -> turnaround -> read until the device names itself (the latency, MEASURED) -> turnaround -> FAR, RCFG, FDRO(0), Type-2 606 -> 32 NOOP flush -> turnaround -> discard the measured latency and one whole frame -> five frames -> turnaround -> DESYNC
sequencer_as_built.far: each envelope's FIRST TARGET FAR, the same one its own preamble wrote
sequencer_as_built.new_fault_code: F_RBSYNC = 12, raised when the probe never sees the IDCODE — distinct from F_READBACK so 'the read path never came up' and 'it came up and disagreed' are different findings on the board
sequencer_as_built.latency_is_measured_not_pinned: the one number simulation cannot establish is taken from the device at run time, against a known answer

results.sweep: the readback bench passes at read latencies 0,1,3,5,7,12 and device flush requirements 32,40,48,64 — the design is not allowed to know either number
results.sweep_is_verified_by_content: each run prints the parameters it was elaborated with and the runner refuses the result unless they match what it asked for; a quoting slip had previously made -P silently fail and run the default seven times
results.provenance_test: one word of the model's configuration memory is changed between the write and the readback, with the DUT's staging copy still holding the written value: the readback must FAIL, which a DUT reading its own buffer cannot do
results.host_bytes: the fifteen frames the host reads out of the staging window are compared word by word against the fifteen it sent — the SHA-256's raw material, checked as bytes rather than trusted because a CRC agreed
results.mutants: 10 run, 10 behaved as expected (9 killed, 1 expected survivor)
results.expected_survivor: shortening the pipeline flush from 32 clocks to 2 is ABSORBED, because the probe then measures a correspondingly longer latency. The flush stops being load-bearing precisely because the latency is measured; the same mutation against a device wanting 64 clocks pushes the probe past its 64-word cap and is refused with F_RBSYNC

how_each_mutant_dies.no_rcfg: F_READBACK, device reports E_NO_RCFG — nothing was ever established
how_each_mutant_dies.wrong_far: F_READBACK — the frames at that address are not this envelope's
how_each_mutant_dies.short_fdro: F_READBACK — the stream runs out and idle words are CRC'd
how_each_mutant_dies.no_dummy_discard: F_READBACK — the flush frame is compared against frame 0's CRC
how_each_mutant_dies.dummy_off_by_one: F_READBACK — one frame late runs off the end of what was asked for
how_each_mutant_dies.short_flush_past_cap: F_RBSYNC — the probe gives up before the device answers
how_each_mutant_dies.csib_low_turn: F_RBSYNC, device reports E_ABORT — the configuration was aborted
how_each_mutant_dies.no_bitswap: F_RBSYNC — a SelectMAP-order stream never syncs
how_each_mutant_dies.lat_hardcoded: F_READBACK — the capture starts three words early

benches_repaired.tb_carrier_stream.v: its echo device — the one erratum 004 names — replaced by icape2_model; its subject (when five frame CRCs may be used as authority) is unchanged
benches_repaired.tb_carrier_chain.v: left alone: a board-replay diagnostic with no pass/fail verdict and no readback
benches_repaired.tb_carrier_scorer.v: left alone: fails 30 identically before and after, pre-existing and out of scope

not_done: no Vivado run, so no utilisation figure for the added states — the region has 800 LUTs and the design used 432 before this
no bitstream, no publication chain, no board time, no push
the AXI status register is unchanged, so the measured latency is not visible to the host yet — see the sequence document's open decision

gate_carrier_base now REFUSES the published erratum-003 run — 'vivado/carrier/carrier_stream.v has changed since the bitstream was built'. That refusal is correct and is the ledger entry saying a rebuild is owed; the 973-test suite is green because it exercises the gate's logic against fixtures, not the production run
carried_assumptions: docs/claimb_icape2_readback_sequence.md section 9 — chiefly that the probe's latency equals the frame read's, and that a DESYNC makes the frame still in the buffer ineligible to commit
